Cloud provider utilities

Usage:
  erun cloud [command]

Available Commands:
  init        Initialize cloud provider configuration
  login       Login to a configured cloud provider alias
  oidc        Refresh the OIDC issuer for a configured cloud provider alias
  refresh     Refresh an environment's in-pod host AWS credentials
  set         Set the cloud provider alias for an environment

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for cloud

Global Flags:
      --output string   Result format: text (default, human stream) or json (structured result on stdout for orchestrators). (default "text")
      --time            Print the elapsed runtime after the command finishes.
  -v, --verbose count   Increase verbosity: -v streams external tool output, -vv adds erun command traces.

Use "erun cloud [command] --help" for more information about a command.
